summary: Implement core PLATES-CORE marker parser, strict validator (no nesting, unclosed/orphan detection), section finder, and conservative merge-with-local-preservation strategy. Local edits inside markers are preserved; outside markers remain fork-owned. Delivers the scanner/parser/sync contract for Issue #130 / Epic #89 / Epic #126. All aligned tests now pass.
migration_guidance: No user migration required. The runtime is new; existing PLATES-CORE comments in AGENTS.md and template files continue to work as before.
